story: Ben and Anna are at the school library to study. They work on their English and French lessons at a desk. Ben practices his maths and checks if his answers are correct.
title: Study Time
setting: A quiet school library with wooden desks and many books.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: A young boy with short brown hair and a blue sweater.

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: A young girl with long black hair and a red shirt.

sentences.en: Ben and Anna are in the library.
sentences.zh: Ben 和 Anna 在图书馆里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a boy with short brown hair and blue sweater, and Anna, a girl with long black hair and red shirt, sit in a quiet library.

sentences.en: The two students sit at a desk.
sentences.zh: 这两个学生坐在书桌旁。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and Anna sit together at a large wooden desk in the library.

sentences.en: Anna enjoys reading her French book.
sentences.zh: Anna 喜欢阅读她的法语书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna holds an open book with a small French flag on the cover.

sentences.en: Ben does English writing for a minute.
sentences.zh: Ben 做英语写作练习一分钟。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben writes in a notebook for a short minute.

sentences.en: He must practise every new English word.
sentences.zh: 他必须练习每一个新的英语单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben looks at a list of English words in a small notebook.

sentences.en: He studies difficult grammar and maths too.
sentences.zh: 他也学习很难的语法和数学。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben looks at a page filled with math numbers and grammar rules.

sentences.en: Ben checks if his answer is correct.
sentences.zh: Ben 检查他的答案是否正确。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben looks closely at a math problem in his book.

sentences.en: Even Anna believes he is very smart.
sentences.zh: 甚至 Anna 也相信他非常聪明。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna smiles and looks at Ben with encouragement.
